_arch_note: RESIDUAL-STACK HYBRID diagnostic (task c6913c9e). Distinct from the parallel convex-gate arm (0217). Each block, AFTER the attention residual, runs two sub-blocks IN SERIES, each with its own LayerNorm + residual + a learnable per-layer LayerScale scalar (init 0.1, NO penalty): x1 = x + s_ffn*FFN(ln_a(x)); x2 = x1 + s_lut*LUT(ln_b(x1)). PRIMARY order FFN->LUT (hybrid_stack_order='ffn_lut'; reverse 'lut_ffn' supported for a control, not run now). FFN sub-block = standard 4x GELU (d_ff 1536, bias=False); LUT sub-block = plain 0207 (light/constant/margin, H8 tph64 nap8 read_top_n1, inner 48/48 full-rank) -- SAME as 0217 so the two diagnostics are directly comparable. Both branch outputs zeroed at init (mlp last Linear + LUT decompress weight); LayerScale scalars 0.1 dial each branch up as it trains. INSTRUMENTATION (the point): every eval logs per layer s_ffn, s_lut AND the realized output-norm ratios ||s_ffn*FFN(ln_a(x))||/||x1|| and ||s_lut*LUT(ln_b(x1))||/||x2|| (mean over batch) -> columns sffn_L*, slut_L*, rffn_L*, rlut_L*; shows which branches train up vs stay near zero, per layer. Single 16k run, seed 1, g-series optimizer/lr (lr 3e-4 wd 0.1 warmup 0.1, device_batch 12 x grad_accum 4 = 24576 eff), corrected fixed eval bs48x100 skip12. TRITON_CACHE_DIR set. QUEUED BEHIND exp_g_0217 (the hybrid_gate run) -- launches only after 0217 frees its slot, so no more than 2 GPU-heavy jobs co-reside.
